faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CURAJ Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Project Assistant post at Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications via email well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Assistant in CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Assistant post in the Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position offering a good opportunity for eligible candidates in the life science field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CURAJ Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Assistant posts at CURAJ is via Email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Assistant position at CURAJ?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position at Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) will receive a salary of Rs. 29700 Per Month. This is a contractual role based in Ajmer, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Assistant post must have an M.Sc. in Physiology, Zoology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, or any branch of life science. A good academic record from a recognized university/institute is also required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CURAJ Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the CURAJ Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. Candidates from all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST, are exempt from paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CURAJ Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position at Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the CURAJ Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant post under Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) Recruitment 2026 is Ajmer, Rajasthan. This offers an opportunity to work in a central university environment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ)?
faq.answer: The official website for Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is http://www.curaaj.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information about the university and official notifications.

faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is a Contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a specific period as outlined in the official notification for the project.
